A reflective thematic analysis was conducted to synthesize how these communities are represented in terms of organizational structures, collaborative inquiry and pedagogical knowledge production. title: Hands‐on and Minds‐on? Findings on the Instructional Support of Preschool Teachers to Foster Children's Understanding of Scientific Practices
abstract: ABSTRACT To participate effectively in modern society, it is essential to have both knowledge of scientific concepts and an understanding of scientific practices. title: Exam Preview Methods Are Associated With Improvements for the Experiences and Learning of College Science Students
abstract: ABSTRACT College science exams are an important and widespread marker for student progress toward technical careers. Predominantly enacted using traditional teaching practices, exams also represent an opportunity for significant improvement in higher education.
